description: Send HTTP requests to your Laravel app, keep them in the workspace, and read the response without leaving the editor.
untrustedWorkspacesDescription: Requests are sent only when you press Send, but a folder you do not trust could include a request file that points anywhere.
welcomeContents:
No API collections yet.
[New Collection](command:redCode.api.newCollection) · [New Request](command:redCode.api.newRequest) · [New Request from Laravel Route](command:redCode.api.newRequestFromRoute)
Requests are plain JSON in `.redcode/api/collections`, so you can review, diff and commit them.
variablesDescription: Variables available to every request as `{{name}}`. `.env` values and the selected environment file are merged on top of these.
environmentDescription: Name of the environment file in `.redcode/api/environments/<name>.json` whose variables are used. Empty means no environment file.
timeoutDescription: How long to wait for a response before the request is cancelled.
verifyTlsDescription: Verify TLS certificates of HTTPS endpoints. Turn this off only for a local server with a self-signed certificate.
followRedirectsDescription: Follow up to five HTTP redirects and show the final response.
laravelCsrfDescription: Send `X-XSRF-TOKEN` from the `XSRF-TOKEN` cookie, and fetch `/sanctum/csrf-cookie` before a non-GET request when that cookie is still missing.
